summary: Sibanye Stillwater Ltd filed a Form 6-K on May 13, 2026, which is a routine report of a foreign private issuer under the Securities Exchange Act of 1934. The filing consists solely of a cover page with company information, officer signatures, and an attached market release exhibit (99.1) that appears to be an ordinary business update. No special-situation transaction such as an acquisition, divestiture, going-private, restructuring, or similar event is announced. The Form 6-K serves as a periodic disclosure for foreign issuers, comparable to a Form 8-K for US domestic companies, but here it contains only regulatory housekeeping and no material corporate event. There are no deal terms, no board recommendation, and no transaction mechanics described.
